## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Armour Dental Care?
Old No. 12-A, New No. 10, 2nd Floor, Dhandeeswaram Main Road, Dhandeeswaram Nagar, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Armour Dental Care have?
General dentistry, Pediatric dentistry, Implant dentistry, Endodontics (root canals), Orthodontics, Periodontics, Prosthodontics, Oral & maxillofacial surgery, Oral medicine & radiology, Fluoride treatments & sealants, Teeth whitening, Athletic mouth guards, Urgent care (trauma, infection).

### Do you treat children?
Yes. Armour is a general and pediatric dental clinic, with a pedodontist on the team.

### What does pediatric care include?
Check-ups, cleaning, fluoride treatments, sealants, fillings and crowns, extractions, space-maintainers, mouth guards and urgent care.
